arxiv-2109-10473.title: MVM3Det: A Novel Method for Multi-view Monocular 3D Detection
arxiv-2109-10473.creator: Haoran Li, Zicheng Duan, Mingjun Ma, Yaran Chen, Jiaqi Li, Dongbin Zhao
arxiv-2109-10473.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Haoran Li, Zicheng Duan, Mingjun Ma, Yaran Chen, Jiaqi Li, Dongbin Zhao. Monocular 3D object detection encounters occlusion problems in many application scenarios, such as traffic monitoring, pedestrian monitoring, etc., which leads to serious false negatives. Multi-view object detection effectively solves this problem by combining data from different perspectives. However, due to label confusion and feature confusion, the orientation estimation of multi-view 3D object detection is intractable, which is important for object tracking and intention prediction.

arxiv-2203-12580.title: Maximum entropy quantum state distributions
arxiv-2203-12580.creator: Alexander Altland, David A. Huse, Tobias Micklitz
arxiv-2203-12580.description: Abstract We propose an approach to the realization of many-body quantum state distributions inspired by combined principles of thermodynamics and mesoscopic physics. Its essence is a maximum entropy principle conditioned by conservation laws. We go beyond traditional thermodynamics and condition on the full distribution of the conserved quantities.

arxiv-2212-01465.title: Early-Forming Massive Stars Suppress Star Formation and Hierarchical Cluster Assembly Journal: ApJ Facilities: Cartesius; SURF - Dutch National Supercomputing Center Torch ( Wall et al. 2019 ; Wall et al. 2020 ) , AMUSE ( Portegies Zwart et al. 2009 ; Portegies Zwart et al. 2013 ; Pelupessy et al. 2
arxiv-2212-01465.creator: Sean C. Lewis, Stephen L. W. McMillan, Mordecai-Mark Mac Low, Claude Cournoyer-Cloutier, Brooke Polak, Martijn J. C. Wilhelm, Aaron Tran, Alison Sills, Simon Portegies Zwart, Ralf S. Klessen, Joshua E. Wall
arxiv-2212-01465.description: Abstract Feedback from massive stars plays an important role in the formation of star clusters. Whether a very massive star is born early or late in the cluster formation timeline has profound implications for the star cluster formation and assembly processes. We carry out a controlled experiment to characterize the effects of early-forming massive stars on star cluster formation.

arxiv-2407-13343.title: Learning-From-Mistakes Prompting for Indigenous Language Translation
arxiv-2407-13343.creator: You-Cheng Liao , Chen-Jui Yu , Chi-Yi Lin , He-Feng Yun, Yen-Hsiang Wang, Hsiao-Min Li, Yao-Chung Fan Department of Computer Science and Engineering,National Chung Hsing University, Taiwan yfan@nchu.edu.tw
arxiv-2407-13343.description: Abstract Using large language models, this paper presents techniques to improve extremely low-resourced indigenous language translations. Our approaches are grounded in the use of (1) the presence of a datastore consisting of a limited number of parallel translation examples, (2) the inherent capabilities of LLMs like GPT-3.5, and (3) a word-level translation dictionary.

arxiv-2412-21133.title: Irreducible representations of welded braid group
arxiv-2412-21133.creator: Inna Sysoeva
arxiv-2412-21133.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Inna Sysoeva. In this paper we study irreducible matrix representations of the welded braid group W ​ B n WB_{n} , also known as the group of conjugating automorphisms of a free group F n . We prove that W ​ B n WB_{n} has no irreducible representations of dimension r , r, where 2 ⩽ r ⩽ n − 2 2\leqslant r\leqslant n-2 for n ⩾ 5 .

arxiv-2503-22661.title: Non-linear and non-empirical double hybrid density functional
arxiv-2503-22661.creator: Danish Khan
arxiv-2503-22661.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Danish Khan. We develop a non-linear and non-empirical (nLanE) double hybrid density functional derived from an accurate interpolation of the adiabatic connection in density functional theory, incorporating the correct asymptotic expansions. By bridging the second-order perturbative weak correlation limit with the fully interacting limit from the semi-local SCAN functional, nLanE-SCAN is free of fitted parameters while providing improved energetic predictions compared to SCAN for moderately and strongly correlated systems alike.

arxiv-2505-18392.title: Applications of Modular Co-Design for De Novo 3D Molecule Generation
arxiv-2505-18392.creator: Danny Reidenbach Filipp Nikitin Olexandr Isayev Saee Paliwal
arxiv-2505-18392.description: Abstract De novo 3D molecule generation is a pivotal task in drug discovery. However, many recent geometric generative models struggle to produce high-quality 3D structures, even if they maintain 2D validity and topological stability. To tackle this issue and enhance the learning of effective molecular generation dynamics, we present Megalodon–a family of scalable transformer models.

arxiv-2512-07554.title: A simple proof of exponential decay for the near-critical planar Ising model
arxiv-2512-07554.creator: Jianping Jiang, Frederik Ravn Klausen
arxiv-2512-07554.description: Abstract . For the Ising model defined on a ​ ℤ 2 a\mathbb{Z}^{2} at critical temperature with external field a 15 / 8 ​ h a^{15/8}h , we give a simple and elementary proof that its truncated two-point function decays exponentially. The proof combines the high temperature expansion, random-cluster and random current representations.

pmc-10701333.title: Time series analysis-based seasonal autoregressive fractionally integrated moving average to estimate hepatitis B and C epidemics in China
pmc-10701333.creator: Yong-Bin Wang, Si-Yu Qing, Zi-Yue Liang, Chang Ma, Yi-Chun Bai, Chun-Jie Xu
pmc-10701333.description: BACKGROUNDHepatitis B (HB) and hepatitis C (HC) place the largest burden in China, and a goal of eliminating them as a major public health threat by 2030 has been set. Making more informed and accurate forecasts of their spread is essential for developing effective strategies, heightening the requirement for early warning to deal with such a major public health threat.

pmc-10738845.title: ARE OLDER ADULTS’ PERCEPTIONS OF ELDERSPEAK INFLUENCED BY SELF-REPORTED PSYCHOSOCIAL CHARACTERISTICS?
pmc-10738845.creator: Lisa Weimar, Clarissa Shaw
pmc-10738845.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). PROMIS (Patient-Reported Outcomes Measurement Information System) is a system of highly reliable measures of patient-reported health status. Elderspeak is speech that sounds childish to older adults. Use of elderspeak by nursing staff can result in rejection of care. The Iowa Coding Scheme for Elderspeak (ICodE) contains 11 elderspeak attributes: diminutives, childish terms, collectives, short words, directives, reflectives, minimizers, exaggerated praise, laughter, tag questions and exaggerated prosody.

pmc-13596905.title: The gut microbiota as a regulator of intestinal stem-cell fate: bacterial and fungal control of differentiation and regeneration
pmc-13596905.creator: Yetong Shen, Benjamin James Chadwick, Peng Xue, Yiru Gao, Chen Ding
pmc-13596905.description: Intestinal stem cells (ISCs) sustain epithelial homeostasis and regeneration in a niche that is shaped by epithelial, stromal, immune, and microbial inputs. This review examines how bacterial and fungal signals influence ISC activity and epithelial repair through microbial metabolites, immune relays, and epithelial sensing.
